Hi Team Dhaba Cafe & Lounge,

I noticed your cafe has strong 3.9★ reviews across 390+ customer visits on New Dak Bunglow Road in Patna, but lacked a dedicated mobile booking and menu page for new diners.

Maine aapke cafe ke liye ek custom live website concept design kiya hai — jisme direct WhatsApp table booking, popular food menu, aur special lounge timings integrate kiye hain:

🔗 https://www.arclanestudios.space/sites/dhabacafe

Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Would love your honest feedback!

— Ameya Sharma, Arclane Studios
callScript: "Hi Team Dhaba Cafe & Lounge, Ameya here from Arclane Studios. Maine aapke business ke liye ek custom live website concept banakar WhatsApp par share kiya tha. Bas ek minute check karna tha ki kya aapko link receive hua aur aapne demo glance kiya? We tailored it specifically with direct WhatsApp table booking, mobile-first speed, and a food menu showcase tailored to New Dak Bunglow Road. Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Agar aapko concept pasand aaye, to hum isme aapki exact dishes, actual interior photos aur pricing setup karke live kar sakte hain. Jab bhi aap free hon batayein, we can connect on a quick 5-minute walkthrough."
